title: Calibrate before you *trust it.*
sub: Six steps between a vendor benchmark and a live revenue gate.

steps.name: Count your labels
steps.detail: Decisions you already made by hand are a free test set.

steps.name: Ask the same question
steps.detail: Same typed question, same options, on those records.

steps.name: Measure the misses
steps.detail: Error rate at every threshold, not one accuracy number.

steps.name: Set the threshold
steps.detail: State its error rate AND the share it sends to review.

steps.name: Shadow run
steps.detail: Log both verdicts. Alert only when they disagree.

steps.name: Cut over
steps.detail: When the disagreements are understood, not when the demo looks good.

quote.text: Start with conservative thresholds, test with your own data, and adjust as you observe results.
quote.cite: TypeSafe docs, on choosing confidence thresholds
